name: Boeuf Bourguignon
body:
Station and Complexity entremetier 6

Flavor Profiles umami, sweet, sour, salty, texture, temperature
Additional Ingredients bitter, spicy, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1d8

DESCRIPTION

A  beef stew braised in red wine and beef stock, flavored with carrots, onions, garlic, and a bouquet garni (parsley stalks, bay leaves and thyme), and garnished with pearl onions, mushrooms, and bacon.

When consumed, it grants resistance to all energy (acid, cold, electricity, fire) equal to your level and light fortification, as the armor special ability, for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1. Each additional ingredient also grants an extra benefit.

Bitter or Umami: Choose one—Gain immunity to one of the above energy types of your choice, or gain moderate fortification for the duration.
Spicy: Gain immunity to fire for the duration.
